newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' Ramos said to be in hospital again.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' Ramos said to be in hospital again.

text.p: Philippines President Fidel Ramos was admitted to hospital again on Sunday for further checks following a throat infection which confined him to bed last weekend, doctors said.

"We are doing more X-rays ... but all the tests are okay," said Raul Fores, director of the Makati Medical Centre, by telephone. Presidential palace official Marcello Lagmay said Ramos, 68, cancelled some appointments on Sunday but added that he did not know if the president was in hospital.
Ramos was previously admitted to the hospital on December 12 and was released three days later after treatement for what doctors said was a throat infection.
Fores said the current tests would be completed by Monday and the president would be then allowed to leave for home.
Doctors had said last week that Ramos was in good health for a man of his age but that he needed to slow down. They denied newspaper reports that he had suffered a mild stroke.
"We are doing doing more X-rays of the rest of the whole body because there were many things we saw during the previous check," said Fores, adding, "his blood chemisty is much better now."
